acceptanceCriteria: The Mozio email confirmation displays the promo code discount amount for the return trip line item when a return ticket order with an applied promo code is submitted.

The Mozio email confirmation displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound and return trip line items when a return ticket order contains multiple line items with reversed toStation/fromStation values and an applied promo code.
The promo code discount amount shown for the return trip in the email confirmation matches the promo discount value applied to that line item in the order payload.

When a return trip order has a promo code that applies a discount of zero to the return portion, the email confirmation displays the promo code amount as 0.00 for the return trip line item rather than omitting it.
The email confirmation correctly renders the promo code discount amount for the return trip regardless of the product code (e.g., senior) or station codes used in the line item metadata.
When the order payload contains a return trip line item without an associated promo discount amount, the email confirmation does not display a promo code discount row for that line item.

acceptanceCriteria: Given a return trip ticket line item with a promo discount, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the dispatch report.price.discount.amount equals the per-line-item discount value for that return trip.

Given a return trip ticket line item with a promo discount, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the dispatch report.price.discount.name contains the promo code name unmasked (masking applies only in sanitized views, not in the submission payload).

Given an order containing both outbound and return trip line items with a promo code, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then each dispatch carries its own discount.amount reflecting the per-line-item discount, not the order-level total discount.

Given a return trip line item with zero discount (promo code does not apply to that portion), When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the discount field is omitted from the dispatch report.price rather than set to an object with amount: 0.

Given a return trip line item, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the fromStation/toStation values remain swapped as they were before this change (no regression in station mapping for return trips).
Given any Mozio dispatch payload, When viewed through the sanitized dispatch view, Then discount masking behavior remains unchanged from the current production behavior.

Given an outbound-only trip line item with a promo discount, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the dispatch report.price.discount.amount is populated correctly (no regression for non-return trips).
Given a return trip line item with no promo code applied, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the discount field is omitted from the dispatch report.price.

Given a return trip line item with a promo discount, When the discount amount is a fractional value, Then the dispatch report.price.discount.amount preserves the expected precision without unintended rounding or truncation.

Given an order with only a return trip (no outbound line item) and a promo discount, When the Mozio submit-order payload is constructed, Then the single dispatch report.price.discount.amount equals the correct per-line-item discount value.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria, so I built on the original story's ACs. Changes: (1) Reworded AC5 and AC6 from original — they referenced specific implementation files (create-reservations.mappers.ts, map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) which violates the what-not-how rule; replaced with observable outcome statements about station swap and masking behavior. (2) Added AC7 — regression check for outbound-only trips to ensure the fix doesn't break existing discount propagation for non-return trips. (3) Added AC8 — edge case for return trips with no promo code at all (distinct from zero-discount case in AC4, which covers when a promo exists but doesn't apply to that portion). (4) Added AC9 — edge case for fractional discount amounts to guard against rounding/truncation issues. (5) Added AC10 — edge case for orders with only a return trip and no outbound line item.
